# Issue

Thanks for opening an issue. Prefer the structured bug, feature, or task forms when available.

Please include:

- the affected repository, package, version, tag, or commit;
- a concise summary of the problem or request;
- steps to reproduce for bugs;
- expected and actual behavior;
- validation already performed;
- any relevant logs with secrets and private data removed.

Do not include secrets, tokens, private keys, customer data, or security exploit details in public issues. Follow the security policy for vulnerability reports.
